coordinate_space: Each already-finalized PNG in its own original pixel coordinates, before display scaling.
body_attachment: Posterior base of neck beneath the hood; not the whole-body or head centroid.
scarf_attachment: Gathered knot or collar overlap from which the cloth tails emerge.
method: All 43 body/scarf pairs individually annotated on source-labelled images, checked with crosshair overlays. Napes partly covered by hair/hood carry roughly 10-15 source-pixel uncertainty; broad collars can carry 20-30. Composite visual verification is required in addition to geometric equality.

frames.notes: Nape under hood/hair at posterior neck just above shoulder; visually identified source point (195,220) in idle-body-00.round-07.png propagated through the actual breathing/settle/head-tilt row warp, then visually verified per frame. No use of BASE_SCARF_OFFSET. Scarf depicts a folded collar, not a discrete knot; attachment center is the lower gathered overlap from which both tails descend, with the actual scarf shear applied.
